programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 60 Seconds to Sharp
programme.desc: Most videos about sharpening, including my own, focus on how to tune up an old tool or properly set a new one. Thankfully, once you do that process it isn't likely you'll have to do it again for a very long time. From that point on, you'll be sharpening in maintenance mode.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Bluetooth Earbud Shootout
programme.desc: Which bluetooth earbud hearing protection will come out on top?

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Bowl Turning Tools & Techniques w/ David Marks
programme.desc: On a recent visit with my friend and mentor, David Marks, we decided to make a little video together. Initially the idea was to simply show David my video production process. But as things started to progress, I knew we had the makings of a great video and this was something I wanted to share with the woodworking community.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Butt Hinge Mortise
programme.desc: While building my 6-panel cabinet recently, I decided to capture the process of mortising for a butt hinge. With a router, a small straight bit, a chisel, and some careful layout, you’ll find mortising for hinges to be fun and easy.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Chiseling a Corner
programme.desc: I recently had to cut a large rabbet using a rabbeting bit which resulted in rounded corners. While this process may be common sense to some, the actual steps taken to achieve a perfect continuation of the rabbeted edge without mangling the integrity of the lines requires quite a bit of attention to detail. So this is a step by step review of my process.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Bit Storage Cabinet
programme.desc: A wall-hanging cabinet to help you organize and store your drill and router bits.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Be a Safety Hero!
programme.desc: Last week I asked you folks for your favorite quick safety tips and you were kind enough to respond with some fun and insightful tricks of the trade. So I took a few of my favorites and bundled them up in this 50's style educational video. I hope you enjoy!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Basic Tool Set for the Beginning Woodworker
programme.desc: There are lots of different opinions out there as to what you actually need to do woodworking. Truth is, you don't need much. Think about our ancestors and what they were able to accomplish using only the most rudimentary tools. But in the 21st century, we aren't building for our survival and most of us have family and day jobs that come before woodworking, so we use modern tools to help us build.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Cleaning Blades & Bits
programme.desc: If you find that your blades and bits just aren't performing like they used to, you might not need to send them out for a sharpening. They might just be in desperate need of a good cleaning.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Coloring Blotchy Woods
programme.desc: This video is from a live demo I did on Wed. Nov 19th, 2008. The topic was staining blotchy woods. After the demo, I’ve included a portion of the Q&A from the chat room. Thanks to everyone who participated!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Carbon Method Update
programme.desc: An update on the effectiveness of Carbon Method's Carbon Coat product for rust prevention in a humid climate.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Carbide-Tipped Brad Point Bits
programme.desc: If you're like me, you probably learned about drill bits the hard way. I started out using a basic set of standard twist bits. As I learned more about the craft and communicated with other woodworkers, I became aware of the superior brad point bit with it's sharp center point and sweet cutting spurs.

programme.desc: CA helps solve a bunch of problems in the shop.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Bent Lamination
programme.desc: A great method for creating curved project components.

programme.title: The Knit Show: The Global
programme.desc: On this episode of The Knit Show with Vickie Howell we celebrate our global community by focusing on yarns, techniques, and designers from around the world.

programme.title: The Knit Show: The Bag
programme.desc: On this episode of The Knit Show with Vickie Howell we go bag crazy! We share some of our favorite project bags; learn how to crochet a boho-inspired purse; take a field trip to an artisanal mill to see how yarn is made; knit a felted bag made unique with different hardware and straps, and get a quick tip for how your favorite knitting tool can also be used as an integral part of your next, big bag!

programme.title: The Knit Show: The Lace
programme.desc: On this episode of The Knit Show with Vickie Howell we open ourselves up to lace — the fabric style created by playing with negative space, using both knit and crochet techniques.

programme.title: The Knit Show: The Big Knits
programme.desc: On this episode of The Knit Show with Vickie Howell we bow down to big knits — chunky, quick-to-make projects knit in the most decadent of bulky yarns.

programme.title: The Knit Show: The Amigurumi
programme.desc: On this episode of The Knit Show with Vickie Howell we’re all about the super, happy, fun time cuteness of Amigurumi — crochet and knit toys. Learn how to crochet an adorable Loaf Kitty and sweet Sloth, plus tips for toy knitting success!
